Chapter 878: Chapter 17 Transfer (Please Subscribe)

“Perhaps the Galaxy Master has come upon some other opportunity?”

Xia Qin Ultimate Being replied.

What Lin Yuan had initiated with his Divine Ability ‘World’ was incredibly powerful, beyond the understanding of Ultimate Beings toward Level Eleven lifeforms.

Thus, in the eyes of many Level Twelve ultimate beings, Lin Yuan must have relied on an external object; it was inconceivable that such a display of power could be achieved on his own.

Even the nine Ultimate Beings of the Human Civilization Alliance instinctively thought the same. They had indeed witnessed the astonishing phenomena when Lin Yuan stepped into Level Eleven.

But without reaching Level Twelve, no matter how profound one’s accumulation is, they remain a lifeform within the river of time.

Relying solely on oneself, one cannot demonstrate that kind of terrifying power, which far surpasses Level Eleven.

In fact, the Ultimate Beings’ thoughts were not wrong.

Without Divine Ability ‘World’, even with Lin Yuan’s strength, sweeping away many Level Eleven powerhouses would require a considerable amount of time.

Tens of thousands of Level Eleven powerhouses, if they scatter in a swarm, Lin Yuan would truly be helpless; after all, he is not an Ultimate Being.

Divine Ability ‘World’ allowed Lin Yuan to fully utilize his strongest advantage: his inner world, which had been enhanced over twenty times by the mysterious gourd and had drawn the attention of the Chaos Void Origin twice…

Multiple factors affected Divine Ability ‘World’ causing its power to vastly exceed expectations.

Of course, the formidable power of Divine Ability ‘World’ was entirely because of Lin Yuan.

Had it been any other being, even a legendary Level Eleven Perfect existence with the exact same Divine Ability ‘World’ as Lin Yuan, they couldn’t have achieved such destructive power.

A legendary Level Eleven Perfect existence, whose inner world is at most tens of millions of miles in scope, what could they do even if they possessed the ‘World’ Divine Ability?

“Should be.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme slightly nodded.

He also agreed with Xia Qin Ultimate Being’s point that the Galaxy Master must have other opportunities.

“The Galaxy Master has truly brought us a great surprise…”

The Xuanyuan Supreme glanced at the Ultimate Beings from the eleven peak clan forces in the distance and a smile appeared on his face.

On any scale of battlefield, when the Human Civilization Alliance contends with other peak clan forces, it usually requires a brutal fight and a long period of clashing to either win a victory or ultimately fail.

Like just now, barely at the beginning of the contention, and there was already a sense of ending—it was the first time the Human Civilization Alliance had experienced this.

“Xuanyuan, those guys seem to have started to join forces.”

The Void God Ultimate Being suddenly spoke up, his voice reaching the ears of the other eight Ultimate Beings of the Human Civilization Alliance.

At this moment, apart from the Human Civilization Alliance, the Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, Star Alliance, and other peak clan forces’ Level Twelve ultimates were subtly rapidly communicating.

Even the Ultimate Being from the usually exceedingly proud Robber Clan showed a slight change in expression, clearly joining the communication.

The Void God Ultimate Being, though uncertain about the specifics of their conversation, was sure it had to do with the Human Civilization Alliance.

“Normal.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme remained calm.

Just like in past wars, in the later stages, other clan forces often join hands to combat the Robber Clan.

Now, due to the overwhelming combat power displayed by the Galaxy Master, he has naturally replaced what was once the ‘Robber Clan,’ and it was natural to be targeted by all peak clan forces.

The Xuanyuan Supreme was not surprised by this. If another peak clan force produced a strong being similar to the Galaxy Master, the Human Civilization Alliance would not face it alone, but would choose to ally.

…

On the edge of the core battlefield area.

Lin Yuan’s figure suddenly appeared, observing his surroundings carefully.

“I remember that the Insect Race’s Hive Mother, carrying the Clan Suppression Weapon ‘Nightmare Realm,’ fled in this direction last.”

Lin Yuan scrutinized every inch of space, multiple Spatial Layers coming into his view, incessantly searching for the trace of the strongest Level Eleven of the Insect Race.

In the center of the battlefield, after obliterating tens of thousands of alien Level Eleven,

Lin Yuan gave several instructions to Xuanyuan You and other evolved humans of the Human Civilization Alliance.

He then personally pursued those twenty or more strongest Level Elevens who managed to escape the range of Divine Ability ‘World’ with their Clan Suppression Weapons.

Though Lin Yuan was quite wary of the Clan Suppression Weapons, which contained tactics from Level Twelve ultimates,

Killing those strongest of Level Eleven, Clan Suppression Weapons aside, would still be a loss for the aliens.

Even if only a clone is killed, it weakens the enemy’s foundation, as creating a clone is not a simple task.

“I can sense the residual trace of causality from the strongest Level Eleven of the Insect Race in this area, but I’m just not certain where it is.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. The ability to avoid his senses must undoubtedly come from that Clan Suppression Weapon.

“Forget it, let’s switch to another one.”

After sensing for a while with no gains, Lin Yuan directly turned and left.

There were more than twenty strongest Level Elevens who managed to escape; if he couldn’t find the Insect Race, then he would switch to the next one.

…

Long after Lin Yuan left.

The strongest of Level Eleven from the Insect Race, hiding within a certain Spatial Layer with the aid of the Clan Suppression Weapon ‘Nightmare Realm,’ breathed a huge sigh of relief.

“How can this Galaxy Master be so strong?”

The strongest of Level Eleven of the Insect Race still trembled somewhat. The greatest effect of Nightmare Realm is to suppress all soul forces, even when wielded by an Ultimate Being.

But now, Nightmare Realm was used by her to conceal her presence and hide herself; the Level Eleven of the Insect Race who had held Nightmare Realms probably had never tried this before.

As a Clan Suppression Weapon, at the Level Eleven tier, it was fundamentally capable of sweeping over others, even when facing the strongest Level Eleven of the Robber Clan. Relying on Nightmare Realm, they could still protect themselves.
